Enthusiastic Cost Engineer wanted! 
As a Cost Engineer you will be working on a daily basis on devising climate systems that have sustainability and food security as starting points. 
( 3 juni 2022 , Erik Schüssel ) 
For a client in the Delft region, active in the international horticultural sector, we are looking for a Cost Engineer Climate/HVAC . 
The Design Team works together with the Sales Department in drawing up quotations for clients. 
You will therefore be busy with calculations, quotations, design drawings of climate installations, climate technical calculations and visiting customers . You will be in frequent contact with colleagues and customers to ensure that the climate systems meet the needs of the customers. 
Who are we looking for in this Cost Engineer position? - You have practical and technical insight - Completed technical education - Experience with climate installations/HVAC is a plus - You speak English (Dutch is an advantage) - Experience with calculating in a technical environment 
You will be working in a team of 3 colleagues, with whom you will be closely involved in challenging projects; every greenhouse needs different climate systems ! 
There are many career opportunities and an attractive remuneration package (basic 35.000 - 55.000 euros/year, 32 vacation days and a profit share). 
Furthermore, as a Cost Engineer you will be working on a daily basis on devising climate systems that have sustainability and food security as starting points.
